world/northwind.json · generated from an integer seed
ONE canonical world file: Northwind Systems, $60M
SaaS, 12 customers, 10 vendors, Apr-Jun + July 2026

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

planted drift written into the world file
Initech $144k deal vs $129.6k invoices · Wayne
$3,300 short · refund posted twice · $12.40 diff
changed vendor bank details · departed employee

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

planted-drift ANSWER KEY
stored OUTSIDE anything an agent can read
no tool, no table, no working-dir path reaches it

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
pnpm seed --target=system or all --reset
restores a clean state per target

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
seeder per target (code), idempotent
every record carries an fn: external id
re-run = upsert on fn: id, never a duplicate
verifies each write by id, not search (HubSpot lag)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
seed manifest
world id → external id per target system
+ world recorded_time per record

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
brief finding: THREE CLOCKS
Q2 is seeded today, so QBO CreateTime, HubSpot

NO-LOOK-AHEAD guard for replay, enforced twice

2 kernel E: trace recorded by T

old version kept immutable, never overwritten

F-11 checkpoint and resume
cursor advances ONLY inside the commit txn
crash → rollback → resume from cursor_before
